caption: The drawing depicts two identical, vertically oriented objects placed side by side against a plain, beige background. Each object resembles a carved wooden baton or staff, primarily brown in color, with a handle at the bottom and an intricate design at the top. The top section of each object features a cluster of leaves and pinecones, with the leaves fanning outward in multiple directions. The design includes detailed veining on the leaves and textured patterns on the pinecones, giving a three-dimensional appearance. Both objects have a slender handle that gradually thickens and branches into the decorative, botanical motifs above. The composition is centered, with ample space surrounding the two objects on all sides.
title: Wood Carving
